private.title: Your Steam profile is private
private.intro: Steam is hiding your library. To let Pytra read it:
private.step1: In Steam, go to your profile → Edit Profile → Privacy Settings.
private.step3: Uncheck "Always keep my total playtime private".
private.retry: Then come back and press "Sync now" (Steam may take a few minutes to apply the change).
